Facilities modeled with a capacity of 3.5 GWdc/yr. 3.3.5 Upstream Inputs for CdTe Modules This section provides limited information on priority inputs to CdTe module production. Refined CdTe powder and glass for CdTe PV are detailed in Sections 3.4 and 3.5. Many other upstream inputs are not discussed owing to limited supply chain information or relatively low importance (e.g., bypass diodes, pigtails, nitrogen, argon, photoresist, and packing material). Sources for some of these inputs were documented in the 2019–2020 timeframe (Smith, Woodhouse, Feldman, et al. 2021), but sourcing has evolved significantly since then. • Refined CdTe powder: See Section 3.4. • Glass: See Section 3.5. • Module frames or back rails: Aluminum frames are used for Series 6 modules, while steel back rails are used for the frameless Series 7 modules. Aluminum frames were imported from Malaysia for Series 6 modules produced in the United States (First Solar 2025a). However, First Solar has a domestic supplier of steel rails for Series 7 modules produced in the United States. It was reported in August 2024 that longtime manufacturing partner Ice Industries will invest $6 million in a facility producing steel back rails for First Solar (Pickerel 2024d). • Encapsulant: First Solar modules are understood to use a polyolefin elastomer (POE) encapsulant (Wesoff 2020). Dow has been named as one POE supplier to First Solar (Semiconductor Today 2020). Other domestic suppliers of POE encapsulant for PV exist, such as H.B. Fuller (HB Fuller 2025), but it is unknown whether First Solar uses multiple suppliers. • Edge seal: Series 7 modules use edge sealant from domestic suppliers to meet 100% of the domestic content criteria determined by the U.S. Treasury (U.S. Internal Revenue Service 2025b). Table 1 in Section 2.3.5 provides information about the domestic supply of edge sealant. • Junction boxes: Series 7 modules use junction boxes from domestic suppliers to meet 100% of the domestic content criteria determined by the U.S. Treasury (U.S. Internal Revenue Service 2025b).
